research_find.title: VWAP Fade on MNQ in Range-Bound Sessions — A 2026 Replication
research_find.description: Researchers replicated the classic intraday VWAP fade on MNQ 5-minute bars during range-bound sessions (ADX < 22) from January 2022 to March 2026. Entry trigger: price extends 1.5 standard deviations above session VWAP, holds for 2 bars, then closes back inside the band. Exit on return to VWAP or 1.5 ATR adverse. Trade only 10:00 ET to 14:30 ET (post opening range, pre last-hour drift). Single-account 50K stats: profit factor 1.89, Sharpe 1.62, average daily P&L $312, max drawdown $1,720, 58% win rate by days. Critical: must disable on news days (FOMC, CPI, NFP) — the authors note 80% of failures clustered around scheduled releases.

input.current_graveyard_summary: No prior VWAP-fade-on-MNQ in graveyard. 2 graveyard MES VWAP fades both lacked confirmation_bars filter.

expected_output.name: range_fade_mnq_vwap
expected_output.description: Fade extensions of MNQ price 1.5 std-dev above/below session VWAP during range-bound sessions; 2-bar confirmation; RTH-only edge per AlphaArchitect 2022-2026 replication.
expected_output.entry_condition: Enter short when price extends 1.5 sigma above VWAP for 2 bars and closes back inside band; mirror long. Disable on FOMC/CPI/NFP days.

notes: Mean-reversion synthesis from a peer-reviewed replication. Strategy correctly tagged RANGE_BOUND with bypass_news_blackout left at default (false) — the news day disable is enforced by the macro gate, not the strategy logic. deviation_threshold=1.5 sits in canonical range (0.5-3.0). Note that take_profit_atr_multiple > stop_loss_atr_multiple, satisfying schema invariant. max_contracts=5 conservative for a fade strategy where multiple losers can stack.
